## What changed and why

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results. State any platform or live-model/device
check you could not run. Include screenshots for a visible UI change.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I removed credentials and private data from code, logs, and screenshots.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the applicable license and retained third-party notices.
- [ ] I preserved the relevant permission, cancellation, and recovery behavior.
